title.narrative: Reinforced partnerships and alliances for development cooperation

description.narrative: The ILO develops partnerships and alliances for development cooperation with a view to strengthening the capacity of the constituents to implement effective and efficient initiatives aligned with the ILO policy outcomes and national priorities, and tailored to the specific socio-economic and cultural contexts. The Development Cooperation Strategy 2026-29 prioritizes the deepening of longstanding partnerships, while diversifying partners and leveraging new forms of partnerships; promoting a shift from a project to a programmatic approach for greater impact; and enhancing effectiveness and efficiency of development cooperation, while strengthening tripartite constituent ownership across the project management cycle. Improving accountability, planning, monitoring, reporting, and transparency regarding resource use and achieved results remains a priority.
